summary: Added analyst orch report: readers/orch.py (orch.* events via aicore.ext.events + stage-report, review-verdict, prompt manifests, risk.json; problems listed, nothing guessed), orch_report.py (build/markdown/cmd_orch) and the `orch` command in cli.py. Report: tokens by role/model/skill, review rounds and findings by severity, reviews added by risk, deviations by class/outcome recorded vs resolved, provider waits and fallbacks, long stages, budgets over limit, plan against actual (--planned FILE), PLAN3 baseline comparison (--baseline FILE). Fixture journal, tests/test_orch_report.py (9 tests) and a package golden (tests/fixtures/orch/report.golden.json). Help line added to bin/analyst, docs/guide/cli.md and CHANGELOG; hub goldens analyst-help and analyst-unknown-subcommand recaptured with --reason. V1 (affected-tests --run --no-cache) exit 0 after the last edit.
